correctness.rationale: Exhaustive four-case articulation filtration; canonical augmented-chain exterior lattice identification; all E1 groups supported in strictly descending total degrees across increasing filtration, so higher differentials and additive extensions vanish integrally. Corollary 3.4 of arXiv:2602.09623v1 supplies shellability, and Björner–Wachs Theorem 4.1 upgrades known integral Betti numbers to a wedge. All 8 finite GF2 homology cases and 182 product-cycle-type Lefschetz comparisons passed. Finite experiments are corroboration, not the general proof.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The block-graph shellability theorem covers the graph but does not determine its homology multiplicities. The general wedge-of-spheres theorem is conditional on those multiplicities; neither is a dominating quantitative classification.

value.rationale: The three-block clique path is the smallest block-path topology with two distinct cut vertices. Closed Betti formulas in exactly three consecutive degrees and integral augmentation-exterior symmetry modules answer a concrete quantitative problem left open by general shellability. General parameters t,p,q,r are covered, not a numerical slice.
